quest.q1.title: First Light
quest.q1.summary: Your first solo sortie. A distress call from home, three errors in the core, and an order you cannot refuse. Start with what you hear.
quest.q2.title: Quiet Dock
quest.q2.summary: The station survives but cannot afford to pay. Decide what matters more: the dock's safety or its livelihood. Both answers are right — and both cost something.
quest.q3.title: Salt and Ash
quest.q3.summary: The caravan missed contact. The hold carries salt, and under the salt three crates someone will kill for. Find who profits.
quest.q4.title: Courier
quest.q4.summary: A container, two jumps, and a patrol on the route. Maev never asks what is inside. The question is whether you do.
quest.q5.title: Inspection
quest.q5.summary: A routine audit. Clause 12, subclause 4. Inspector Reyn never takes a bribe first — but she never refuses one either.
quest.q6.title: Echo in the Core
quest.q6.summary: SVET says «three errors». They are not errors: the core is tuned to something, and someone at the edge of the map answers.
quest.q7.title: First Verge
quest.q7.summary: An outpost on the frontier. Skar's fleet is coming for it. You have three ticks and three options: fight, talk, or trap.
quest.qside.title: A Rumour from the Tattered Pack
quest.qside.summary: A rumour from the Tattered Pack: the pirates keep a cache of someone else's cargo. Or it is a trap — rumours here are rarely free.
quest.qside.s1: Check the cache in the belt
quest.qside.s2: Decide what to do with the cargo
quest.qside.s3: Close the deal with the Pack
dlg.q1.n01: Dock Light-1, zero six forty. Flagship ready for departure. Three errors in the core. Not critical. For now.
dlg.q1.n02: Admiral, Command is on the line. Ceremony in forty seconds. Do not make them wait.
dlg.q1.c1: SVET is hiding something. You can still ask — or it is already too late.
dlg.q1.c1.a: I go now. The core can wait.
dlg.q1.c1.b: Three ticks for diagnostics. The station can wait.
dlg.q1.n04: Light-1 calling anyone! Repeat: anyone! Three of us... raiders in the belt... the airlock is failing...
dlg.q1.n05: Diagnostics: core deviation zero point four percent. Class norm is zero. I will remember this.
dlg.q1.c2: The debris belt. Two corvettes and a frigate. The frigate searches rather than raids. Decide whom to strike first.
dlg.q1.c2.a: The leader. Skar must not escape.
dlg.q1.c2.c: No shots. Scare them into withdrawing.
dlg.q1.n07: Engagement over. Losses: none. Salvage: two containers and a raider black box. The station answers.
dlg.q1.n08: You came. You actually came. Three wounded and two ticks of medicine left. What do we do?
dlg.q1.n10: You did better than I expected. That is not a compliment — it is an estimate.
dlg.q1.n11: You were three ticks late. The station lost a module. I will remember.
dlg.q1.c3: Report. Everything, as it is. Command is listening.
dlg.q1.c3.b: Hide it. The core is fine.
dlg.q1.n13: Logged in the watch journal: first sortie complete.
dlg.q1st.k1: You have entered the dock. It smells of soot and cooling metal. Medbay is to starboard.
dlg.q1st.k2: Three wounded. Two ticks of medicine. Dock repairs cost money. Decide.
dlg.q1st.k2.c: The cargo is a prize. So is the dock.
dlg.q1st.k3: I will remember. I do not know what this is paid with, but I will remember.
dlg.q1st.k4: Eight hundred. Standard rate. No hard feelings?
dlg.q1st.k5: So you are one of them too. We will manage. Without you. Next time, do not answer the call.
dlg.q1sv.v1: Engagement over. Shields at nine percent, hull nominal. You are unharmed.
dlg.q1sv.v2: I recorded your course. It diverged from the order by two point three seconds. Not critical. For now.
dlg.q1sv.v3: SVET keeps its own watch: three errors in the core, one in the admiral.
